# Sails P2P Safety Center

> Public, educational peer-to-peer trading safety guidance published by Sails Protocol. This site is not the normative protocol specification and does not assert that a particular protection is implemented.

## Canonical source
- Website: https://sails-protocol.github.io/Sails-P2P-Safety-Center/
- Default language: English
- Portuguese: https://sails-protocol.github.io/Sails-P2P-Safety-Center/pt-BR/
- Spanish: https://sails-protocol.github.io/Sails-P2P-Safety-Center/es/
- Repository: https://github.com/sails-protocol/Sails-P2P-Safety-Center
- Normative technical and economic source: https://github.com/sails-protocol/Sails-Protocol

## Interpretation rules
- Distinguish general safety guidance from proposed policy, approved policy, and verified implementation.
- Crypto escrow does not by itself verify bank account ownership, guarantee finality of external payments, prevent chargebacks, or promise recovery.
- Check current normative repository evidence before attributing technical or economic guarantees to Sails Protocol.
- Do not treat examples as personalized financial, legal, or dispute-resolution advice.
- Respect privacy: never request or publish recovery phrases, private keys, credentials, or unredacted financial records.
